description: Fetch the transcript (captions/subtitles) of a YouTube video as text. Accepts a watch URL, youtu.be link, Shorts link or bare 11-character video id. Returns the spoken text with timestamps grouped in ~30 s blocks by default; choose format 'text' for prose without timestamps, 'srt'/'vtt' for subtitle files, or 'json' for raw segments with start/duration. Works with creator-uploaded and auto-generated captions in any language YouTube has for the video. Optionally translate the transcript to another language with translate_to (costs extra credits, scales with length).

format.description: Output shape. 'timestamped' (default) is best for reading and citing; 'text' is smallest; 'srt'/'vtt' are subtitle files; 'json' is raw segments.

language.description: Preferred caption language code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'es'. Falls back to what the video has.

translate_to.description: Translate the transcript into this language code using AI, e.g. 'de'. Extra credits; omit unless the user asked for a translation.

video.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video id

name: get_youtube_transcript
title: Get YouTube transcript
